A ChangeLocation Story-Manager quest that fires only in a location with a LocType keyword (locationFilter, OR'd), not more often than cooldownHours (anti-spam, EE_WITimeout), and on fire dynamically spawns 3 bandits near the player on valid navmesh (spawn → MFDynamicSpawn). The build appends GetKeywordDataForCurrentLocation conditions, creates a <quest>_LastFired GLOB + MFEncounterCooldown script, and attaches MFDynamicSpawn with the form/count/distance props. ⚠ locationFilter conditions are pure CTDA (offline-verifiable); the cooldown + spawn SCRIPTS' runtime behaviour (GetCurrentGameTime / PlaceAtMe + EnableAI navmesh snap) need a main-machine in-game check (see WAIT_USER). FormIDs here are real vanilla (LocTypeBanditCamp 0x130F2, LocTypeDungeon 0x130DE, EncBandit01 0x1BCC0) — verify with `gamedata find`.

storyEvent._: Fires only in a bandit camp OR a dungeon, at most once per 12 in-game hours.

spawn._: On fire: 3 EncBandit01 placed 1200-3500 units around the player, snapped to navmesh.
